name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max 256GB
description: Experience flagship performance with the latest processor, stunning display, and professional-grade camera system. Enjoy all-day battery life, premium design, and lightning-fast connectivity. Perfect for photography, gaming, and productivity. Built to deliver a smooth and reliable smartphone experience every day.

name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
description: The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra combines a brilliant AMOLED display with powerful performance and advanced AI features. Capture stunning photos with its versatile camera system and enjoy long-lasting battery life. Designed for multitasking, gaming, and creative professionals.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones
description: Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones offer industry-leading noise cancellation and exceptional sound quality. Enjoy crystal-clear calls, immersive audio, and long battery life. Their lightweight design provides all-day comfort for travel, work, and entertainment.

name: JBL Flip 6 Bluetooth Speaker
description: The JBL Flip 6 delivers powerful sound with deep bass in a compact and waterproof design. Perfect for indoor and outdoor use, it offers long battery life and Bluetooth connectivity. Take your music anywhere with premium JBL audio.

name: Balaji Masala Masti Wafers
description: Balaji Masala Masti Wafers are crispy potato chips seasoned with a flavorful blend of Indian spices. A perfect snack for tea time, parties, or movie nights. Fresh, crunchy, and full of irresistible taste.

name: Parle-G Biscuits
description: Parle-G Biscuits are India's favorite tea-time biscuits, loved for their delicious taste and quality. Made with wholesome ingredients, they provide a quick source of energy. Perfect for kids and adults alike.

name: Britannia Good Day Cookies
description: Britannia Good Day Cookies are loaded with rich buttery flavor and crunchy cookie goodness. Every bite is packed with premium ingredients for a delightful snack. Enjoy them with tea, coffee, or anytime cravings.

name: Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk
description: Cadbury Dairy Milk Silk offers a rich, smooth, and creamy chocolate experience. Crafted with premium cocoa and silky milk chocolate, it melts perfectly in every bite. Ideal for gifting and celebrating special moments.

name: Cadbury Gems
description: Cadbury Gems are colorful chocolate-coated treats loved by children and adults alike. Enjoy the crunchy candy shell with delicious milk chocolate inside. A fun snack for every occasion.

name: Kinder Joy
description: Kinder Joy combines creamy milk and cocoa layers with crispy wafer bites and a surprise toy. A delightful treat specially made for kids and families. Enjoy sweetness with every bite.

name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Gen)
description: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Gen) feature Active Noise Cancellation, Spatial Audio, and crystal-clear sound. Their comfortable fit and long battery life make them ideal for music, calls, and entertainment. Experience premium wireless audio.

name: Samsung 25W Fast Charger
description: Samsung 25W Fast Charger delivers efficient and reliable charging for compatible devices. Compact and lightweight, it's perfect for travel or everyday use. Charge your smartphone quickly and safely.

name: Anker USB-C Charging Cable
description: The Anker USB-C Charging Cable is built for durability and high-speed charging. It supports fast charging and reliable data transfer for smartphones, tablets, and laptops. Designed to last through thousands of bends.

name: Spigen Crystal Clear iPhone Case
description: Protect your iPhone with the Spigen Crystal Clear Case featuring shock-absorbing technology and a slim transparent design. It preserves your phone's original look while providing everyday protection from drops and scratches.

name: Fresh Red Apple
description: Fresh Red Apples are naturally sweet, juicy, and packed with vitamins and antioxidants. Perfect for healthy snacking, desserts, or fruit salads. Enjoy farm-fresh quality with every bite.

name: Premium Banana

name: Fresh Orange

name: Seedless Green Grapes

name: Coca-Cola 2L Bottle

name: Pepsi 2L Bottle

name: Sprite Lemon Soft Drink

name: Fanta Orange Drink

name: Amul Gold Milk 1L

name: Amul Butter 500g

name: Mother Dairy Curd

name: Amul Cheese Slices

name: Ray-Ban Aviator Sunglasses

name: Oakley Sport Sunglasses
description: Oakley Sport Sunglasses provide superior comfort, durability, and UV protection. Designed for active lifestyles, they offer a secure fit and modern sporty look. Perfect for cycling, running, and outdoor sports.

name: Michael Kors Leather Handbag
description: Michael Kors Leather Handbag combines luxury, elegance, and practicality. Crafted from premium materials with spacious storage, it complements both casual and formal outfits. A perfect everyday fashion accessory.

name: Fossil Women's Shoulder Bag
description: Fossil Women's Shoulder Bag features premium craftsmanship with a stylish and functional design. It offers multiple compartments for daily essentials while adding elegance to any outfit. Ideal for work, travel, or casual outings.
